titolo: Lettera al mercato del 4 ottobre 2019 Nuova struttura organizzativa dell'IVASS

IVS IVsAPIC

Prot. N° 0233351/19 del 04/10/2019
MARKET CONDUCT SUPERVISION DIRECTORATE
DISTRIBUTION AND FOREIGN OPERATORS SUPERVISION DIVISION II
Ref. to no. of To the insurance undertakings whose head
offices are located in another Member State of
the EEA carrying on business in Italy under the
Classification III 2 8 freedom of establishment or the freedom to
provide services
TO THEIR PREMISES
Subject: New organizational structure of IVASS
Dear Sir/Madam,
We would like to inform you that, with effect from 16 September 2019, IVASS has
changed its internal organizational structure in order to fully and effectively implement the
new tasks assigned to the Institute by the Insurance Distribution Directive (IDD).
The reorganization has involved the former following Directorates: Consumer
Protection, Intermediaries Supervision, Sanctions and Winding Up.
The complete list of the new organizational structure together with a short
description of the tasks assigned to each Directorate/Division is available at the IVASS
website.
In particular, a Market Conduct Supervision Directorate1 has been created, which
supervises over the market conduct of undertakings and distributors, including foreign
insurance undertakings and distributors pursuing business in Italy by way of
establishment or freedom of services, over the POG process and its transparency, as well
as over the payment of insurance benefits. Furthermore, it manages the activities
regarding the pursuit of insurance business in Italy by foreign undertakings as well as the
Single Register of Intermediaries (RUI).
Within this new Directorate, the Distribution and Foreign Operators Supervision
Division II is responsible for managing the activities regarding the pursuit in Italy of
insurance business under FoS and/or FoE regime, including mergers and portfolio
